messages:
From: Olivia James <olivia.james@bluefin.io>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and audit period

Hi Karthik,

We're evaluating vendors for an upcoming platform rollout and our security team flagged that we need Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report (and any applicable bridge letter) to complete the review. Can you confirm: 1) whether you have a Type II report covering at least the 12 months ending May 31, 2024 (or later), and 2) whether you can provide a bridge letter if the report period doesn't cover our procurement window?

Also: what's your recommended way for sharing the report securely? Our security team prefers SFTP or a pre-authenticated cloud link with expiration.

Thanks,
Olivia James
Security Program Manager
BlueFin Analytics
security@bluefin.io

[Attachment: request-form.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12 KB) referenced]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olivia James <olivia.james@bluefin.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and audit period

Hi Olivia — thanks for reaching out and for the clear list of needs. Happy to help. Summary below and a short package + next steps attached.

Quick answers:
- SOC 2 Type II: yes — we have a Type II for the period 2023-06-01 through 2024-05-31.
- Bridge letter: we can provide a standard bridge letter that confirms whether controls changed after the report period and covers the requested procurement window.
- Secure transfer: we can share the report via an expiring, access-controlled cloud link (pre-signed S3) or by secure SFTP. We will follow your preference and provide an access log.

What I'm attaching now:
- SOC2-TypeII-Report-2024-05.pdf (redwood internal copy; sensitive — do not redistribute)
- SOC2-Bridge-Letter-Sample.docx (template we use to generate a customer-specific bridge)

What we normally redact: user identifiers, internal IP addresses, and customer PII/data examples. If BlueFin requires a less redacted copy we can coordinate an NDA-addendum and an on-demand controlled review.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm preferred sharing method (S3 pre-signed link or SFTP). If S3, provide a contact email for link access.
2) Tell us target procurement window you want the bridge to cover (start/end dates).
3) If you need unredacted evidence (audit workpapers), indicate that now so we can route to our compliance team (Marissa cc'd).

Template reply you can reuse internally: 
---
Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II for 2023-06-01 to 2024-05-31. They can produce a bridge letter to extend attestation coverage into our procurement window; report sharing via pre-signed S3 or SFTP is supported.
---

Let me know the sharing preference and target window and we'll get the bridge completed within 3 business days.

Best,
Karthik Iyer

Redwood Inference

1) Procurement window: we need coverage through the end of our contract signature period, currently targeted for 2026-07-15. Can the bridge letter cover up to that date?
2) Sharing method: please send a pre-signed S3 link that expires in 7 days. Access should be granted to olivia.james@bluefin.io and security@bluefin.io.

Also, will your bridge letter explicitly state whether there have been material control changes since the report end date? Our auditors want that call spelled out.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Olivia

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Hi Olivia — confirmed and next steps completed: 

1) Bridge coverage: yes — we will issue a customer-specific bridge letter that covers from 2024-06-01 through 2026-07-15 (the requested procurement window). The bridge will include a statement on material control changes. If controls experienced changes, the bridge will summarize those changes and include whether compensating controls remain in place. If no material changes, the bridge will state that explicitly.

2) Sharing: I uploaded a redacted copy of the Type II report and the bridge letter draft to a pre-signed S3 link with 7-day expiry. Link and access control: https://redwood-secure.s3.amazonaws.com/pre-signed/example?X-Amz-Expires=604800 (expires 2026-05-10T16:45:00-07:00). Access granted to olivia.james@bluefin.io and security@bluefin.io. (If you need a different transfer modality we can switch to SFTP.)

3) Redaction and evidence: The file we shared is redacted per our standard policy (no customer PII, no internal-only IPs). If BlueFin requires reviewer access to audit workpapers, please submit a signed processing addendum and we will provision a controlled review session with our compliance team.

4) Timeline: final signed bridge letter will be delivered within 3 business days after you confirm the target window (confirmed) and accept the draft. If you ask for an expanded, unredacted package there may be an additional 2–4 day lead time while our compliance team coordinates.

5) Internal contacts: Marissa Cole (compliance lead) is on copy and will handle the formal issuance of the bridge letter.

If helpful, here's a short standard template we use for the bridge letter content (you can quote this to your auditors):
---
This bridge letter is provided to BlueFin Analytics and is intended to supplement Redwood Inference's SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending May 31, 2024. As of the date of this letter (May 3, 2026), Redwood Inference confirms: (a) the controls described in the SOC 2 report have been maintained, except as noted below; (b) any material changes are summarized herein; and (c) this letter covers the requested period through July 15, 2026.
---

Please reply to confirm receipt of the S3 link and whether you'd like the bridge letter in DOCX or PDF. Once you confirm we'll finalize and sign it.

Thanks,
Karthik
